analyst.summary: Bombay Burmah Trading Corporation is best understood as a holding company for a 50%+ stake in Britannia Industries, so its results largely mirror Britannia's mature, steady FMCG business rather than any distinct operation of its own. Revenue and profit growth are modest and in line with a large, mature packaged-foods business. The stock's low headline P/E multiple reflects a well-known holding-company discount rather than a genuine bargain - Britannia's own earning power trades at a materially higher multiple as a standalone stock, and that gap has historically persisted rather than closed.
